gold_reason: There is no significant news driving gold prices
indices_reason: U.S. Treasury yields fall as oil prices plunge on Iran de-escalation hopes
lead_story: The US dollar had a poor week due to doubts about the Fed's ability to control inflation, oil prices are falling on hopes of de-escalation in Iran, and the Fed is under pressure to act on inflation which is at its lowest in years, but some officials still think action is needed now.
